violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -Observed boxes of food on floor in walk in freezer.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. -Observed pans on top of hand sink. Hand sink must only be used for hand washing.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. -Observed open bags of food in freezer in kitchen.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Observed outside of appliances in food prep area need to be wiped down.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Observed floors in food prep area need to be cleaned.
